candidate_reports.remark: Multiple trees uprooted_ several large tree limbs snapped. Powerlines down. Radar and damage appear consistent with a microburst with peak winds 70-80 mph.
Report from mPING: Dime (0.75 in.).
Social media post of tree down with other tree limbs snapped off in northern Cape Girardeau County.
Water over Hwy 62 near the Cypress Lake Campground.
Rainfall since midnight.
Multiple power poles downed along US-61 north of Sikeston.
Corrects previous tstm wnd dmg report from 2 NW Sikeston. Multiple power poles downed along US-61 north of Sikeston.
Flash flooding occurred on several roads in Cape Girardeau including Broadway St near Kingshighway.
A truck got stuck and nearly entirely covered with floodwaters in a culvert off of Kingshighway. One person was rescued and taken to a hospital.
Floodwaters covered the baseball field at Central Middle School.
Several water rescues occurred with flash flooding in Cape Girardeau_ with the stranded vehicles including a tow truck. At least one business off of William St flooded.
Large tree limbs downed in Barlow.
Many roads flooded in Scott City including the I-55 off-ramps and in front of a high school. Several portions of Main Street were flooded as well. Hourly rainfall at KCGI was 3.31 inches.
A large section of a tree was downed by thunderstorm winds.
Several trees down in and around Barlow.
Trees down onto KY-849 in Dogwood.
Corrects previous hail report from Hickory.
Corrects previous tstm wnd dmg report from Symsonia. Damage to siding at a mobile home in Symsonia off of KY-534.

Spotter estimated wind gust of 60+ mph in Hickory.
State EOC relayed a report of significant roof damage to a home in Mayfield.
Numerous reports of tree and powerline damage in and around Mayfield.
Trees over at least a half dozen roads in the eastern part of the county.

Tree down on McElrath Rd.
